observation.visible_scene: A still wide landscape shot: a calm, dark-blue lake fills the lower half of the frame, mirroring a range of snow-capped grey mountains under a clear blue sky. A golden-brown grassy hill slopes down on the left to the waterline, lined with dry orange reeds and shrubs; a few bare branches intrude at the right edge and a thin reed at the bottom-left. A small white building and dark trees sit on the far shore at right, with a bright sun-glint reflection nearby.
visible_changes: The real mountains, hill, sky and shoreline stay fixed in position across all frames; no object translates, enters, or leaves.

The lake surface is not perfectly still: faint horizontal ripple lines continuously appear, shift and fade across the reflected image of the snow peaks and the golden hill, so the reflection visibly shimmers and breaks into wavy streaks frame by frame (e.g. the mountain reflection is more streaked/distorted in mid-frames than in the first frame).
The deformation is confined to the reflection in the water; the actual mountains above the waterline show no corresponding motion.
The bare branches on the right and the reed at bottom-left remain essentially motionless throughout the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the surface ripples (wind, a current, a distant disturbance) is not visible.
Whether the water was calmer before frame 1 or settles after frame 41 is unknown; the rippling is already ongoing at the start and continues at the end.
Any camera movement outside this crop is unknown.
uncertain_details: Possible very slight camera drift cannot be confirmed; the background landmarks appear locked, so the scene is treated as a static shot.
The exact texture of the reflection changes are subtle and continuous rather than a discrete event.
